title: Job Openings at Toslad Group
content:
Toslad Group is a forward-thinking real estate and services company committed to delivering excellence across property management, real estate brokerage, facility services, and debt/rent recovery. With a growing portfolio and multiple subsidiaries, we provide clients with reliable, technology-driven solutions that make property ownership and management easier, safer, and more profitable.

We pride ourselves on understanding the needs, lifestyle, and ambitions of our clients. Whether you are an individual, investor, or business enterprise, Toslad Group offers tailored solutions that help you explore opportunities, sustain growth, and unlock long-term value.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below: 
     

            
    



1.) Experienced Accountant (Real Estate)

Job Location: Plot 686, District Opp. Gwagwalada, Park Area 1 - Abuja
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Accountant to manage financial operations within our real estate business.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for financial reporting, project cost tracking, tax compliance, and ensuring accurate financial management across multiple properties and developments.


Key Responsibilities


	Prepare and maintain accurate financial records and reports
	Manage daily accounting operations, including receivables and payables
	Track project costs, budgets, and profitability for real estate developments
	Monitor client payments, rent collections, and service charges
	Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements
	Ensure compliance with tax regulations (VAT, WHT, Company Income Tax)
	Handle bank reconciliations and cash flow management
	Support internal and external audit processes
	Advise management on financial planning and cost control strategies.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
	Must have 3-7 years of accounting experience (real estate experience preferred)
	Professional certification (ICAN, ACCA, or ANAN) is an added advantage
	Strong knowledge of financial reporting and tax regulations
	Proficiency in accounting software (QuickBooks, Sage) and advanced Excel
	Good understanding of real estate accounting (property costing, rent, service charges)
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
	High level of accuracy and attention to detail
	Ability to drive with a valid driver's license (added advantage).


Key Competencies:


	Integrity and professionalism
	Strong communication and reporting skills
	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
	Excellent organizational and time management skills.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Cover Letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

2.) Human Resources Officer 

Job Location: Plot 686, District Opp. Gwagwalada, Park Area 1 - Abuja
Employment Type: Full-Time

Key Responsibilities


	Recruitment & onboarding
	Staff management & welfare
	Employee relations
	HR documentation & records
	Performance management
	Training & development
	HR policies & compliance.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree / HND in HR, Business Administration, Industrial Relations or related field
	Minimum of 3 years of relevant HR experience
	Strong knowledge of recruitment and employee relations Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
	Good knowledge of Nigerian labour laws
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and HR management tools
	CIPM certification is an added advantage.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Cover Letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: For more information contact the recruiter via: +234 907 777 3389, +234 916 003 854

 

3.) Sales Executive (Real Estate)

Job Location: Plot 686, District Opp. Gwagwalada, Park Area 1 - Abuja
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary


	Are you a passionate and result-driven sales professional with an interest in real estate? Toslad Group is looking for a dynamic Sales Executive to join our growing team and drive property sales across our premium developments.


Key Responsibilities


	Generate leads and actively seek new sales opportunities
	Promote and sell company properties to prospective clients
	Conduct site inspections and property presentations
	Build and maintain strong client relationships
	Negotiate deals and close sales effectively
	Achieve and exceed assigned sales targets
	Provide market feedback and insights to management


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Estate Management, or a related field
	Must have 2-5 years of sales experience (real estate experience preferred)
	Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
	Good understanding of real estate processes and documentation
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint)
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team
	Target-driven with a strong desire to succeed


Added Advantage:


	Experience in real estate marketing or property sales
	Digital marketing and social media lead generation skills


What We Offer


	Competitive salary with attractive commission structure
	Opportunity for career growth and professional development
	Supportive and performance-driven work environment


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Cover Letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
